text.method: Monthly sky calendar: sidereal (nirayana) zodiac, Lahiri ayanamsa. No birth data is used (except in the birth-moment declinations section). Event moments are the provider's minute-precision search results; the system does not recalculate them, it only checks their internal consistency.
text.window: The window is the UTC calendar month (the 1st of the month 00:00 UTC → the 1st of the next month 00:00 UTC). Local times are shown for each event with the offset of the selected time zone at that moment (daylight saving time included); some events in the first / last hours of the local month may therefore appear in the neighbouring month's record.
text.aspectVsDrishti: The aspects here are ASTRONOMICAL aspects: the moment when the ecliptic longitude difference of two planets equals a given angle (0°, 60°, 90°, 120°, 180° and the minor aspects). Traditional Vedic graha drishti (Parashari whole-sign aspects: all grahas the 7th, Mars 4/8, Jupiter 5/9, Saturn 3/10) is a SEPARATE method and is shown in the “Graha Drishti” / “Gochara” techniques; this table must not be used in place of drishti.
text.aspectZodiac: The aspect moment depends on the DIFFERENCE of two longitudes; since the ayanamsa cancels out on both sides, the moments are the same in the sidereal and tropical zodiacs. The longitude columns are sidereal (Lahiri) values.
text.declination: Declination parallels are a mathematical domain SEPARATE from ecliptic longitude aspects: angular distance north / south of the celestial equator (declination) is compared. Parallel = two planets at equal declination in the same hemisphere (|d1 − d2| ≤ orb); contraparallel = equal declination in opposite hemispheres (|d1 + d2| ≤ orb). Declination is independent of the zodiac choice (sidereal / tropical).
text.parallelsSampling: The monthly parallel moment is the minute-precision exact moment at which the declinations of two planets become equal (parallel) or equal in opposite hemispheres (contraparallel). The scope is the seven visible planets (Sun … Saturn; no Rahu / Ketu).
text.station: Retrograde / direct station moments are not in this calendar's provider data and are not produced by the system; for sign ingresses only the direction of motion at the moment of crossing (forward / retrograde) is shown. Rahu and Ketu move retrograde by mean motion.
text.natalDeclination: The declinations at the moment of birth and the parallels / contraparallels in the birth chart (orb 1.5°). This section depends on the birth time; it is not calculated if the time is unknown.
